name: Futarikiri no Sekai o Negattara. -Remember Second-
original_name: ２人きりの世界を願ったら。 ―　Remember second　―
source:
One day, I made a wish.
I wished the world could be just you and me.

The next morning, my wish came true.
Everyone around us vanished all at once.

And then, I realized.
Humanity had gone extinct, just as I’d wished—leaving only you and me behind.


[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ011767.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
有一天，我许了一个愿。
我希望这个世界只有你和我。

第二天早上，我的愿望实现了。
我们周围的人一下子都消失了。

然后，我意识到。
正如我所愿，人类灭绝了——只剩下你和我。
